label: Onyx rejects with HTTP 400
description: The service rejects the request as invalid and says why in an OperationOutcome. It models DTR 2.0.1, whose operation answers a failure with an OperationOutcome. The CRD sentinel member ID P32H-BAD400 selects it too, so a case means the same thing in CRD and in DTR.
basis: Synthetic. Shaped to DTR 2.0.1, the version this tool is held to, from the guide's own examples where it has them, with this project's placeholders for every value the guide leaves open. It has not been observed from the live service.

details.text: The request names no order this service can find a questionnaire for.
